data.body: Bedrock alarm Terraform, 2026-11-11 PST. `scripts/terraform_prod.py plan` from a worktree at origin/main b878c4be768 (AWS_PROFILE=frontier): 0 to add, 1 to change, 0 to destroy. The only resource is aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm.bedrock_invoke_client_errors. Its only material diff is the 6 ModelId dimensions moving from opus-4-8 / sonnet-4-6 / haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0 to opus-5-5 / sonnet-5-5 / haiku-5-5, plus the provider's `period = 0 -> null` no-op on each metric_query. The apply (`scripts/terraform_prod.py apply <saved plan>`) was BLOCKED by this session's auto-mode permission classifier (category "Protected-Scope IaC Apply"), despite the recorded production-write authorization, so it is NOT applied. The deployed rebar-bedrock-invoke-client-errors still names the 4.x ids. Also: bedrock-cache-ratio-low-{opus-4-8,sonnet-4-6} and bedrock-unit-cost-high-{opus-4-8,sonnet-4-6} are defined nowhere in this repo (grep over infra/, scripts/ and src/ finds nothing), so Terraform cannot move them to 5.5; they were created outside Terraform.
